Record the number of results and capture any matching documents. **Pass criteria:** - **Pass (answer confirmed):** Zero results are returned, or all results lack any mention of the ICC, confirming that no official press release makes the joint‑award claim. **Fail criteria:** - One or more press releases are found that explicitly state the 2026 Sakharov Prize was jointly awarded to the ICC and its senior officials, disproving the answer. Running this test will provide a definitive, publicly verifiable answer to the council’s question.
